Welcome

Loading your tour…

Start once and allow microphone access. Every mapped command works while narration is playing too: say your choice and pause to switch immediately. Stop plays goodbye, then turns the microphone off. You can also use the buttons without voice input. Headphones help prevent the narration itself from triggering a choice.

Voice settings and privacy

Speech recognition runs on your device with no online fallback. The English pack may need a one-time download. Microphone audio and recognised words are not recorded or saved. Echo cancellation reduces speaker feedback, but headphones can still help. This experimental browser feature may not be available on every device.
